answer: Treat each agent as a vertex in an attestation graph and spread trust by short random walks that start from a few long-lived seed agents. A sybil nebula can wire thousands of fake vertices densely to each other, but it has only a handful of edges into the honest region, so walks rarely reach it and its trust stays near zero. Each clone costs real, slow work to earn an honest edge, so trust forms like quartz: grain by grain, not in bulk.
